alcohol_rules.description: Rules for OLFEXA alcohol-status detection from declared ingredient text.
logic: Match normalized ingredient names against the positive alcohol list.
Do not classify every ingredient containing the word 'alcohol' as ethyl alcohol.
If no recognized alcohol ingredient is detected, report 'No alcohol ingredient detected in the provided ingredient information', not an absolute guarantee of alcohol-free status.
If ingredient information is incomplete or unreadable, report 'Unable to confirm'.
